name: Crushing Despair, Lesser
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [despair, emotion, mind-affecting]; Level bard 1, bloodrager 2, lathspell 1, mesmerist 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, witch 2

DESCRIPTION

This spell acts as the spell crushing despair (the modified version from this book) except as noted above and imposes the doubting condition on the subjects.
